# Anamorphic Store

> > Specialized retailer and educational resource for DSLR anamorphic cinematography, featuring vintage lens kits from Isco, Schneider, Kowa, and Sankor with single-focus conversion solutions.

Anamorphic Store provides both products and comprehensive guides for filmmakers seeking to achieve cinematic widescreen aesthetics using anamorphic lenses on DSLR and mirrorless cameras. The site specializes in vintage anamorphic projection lenses adapted for modern digital cinematography, offering complete kits with rangefinder focusing solutions and single-focus conversion options.

## Key Topics

- Isco anamorphic lenses
- Schneider optics
- DSLR anamorphic cinematography
- Single-focus conversion
- Dual-focus systems
- Rangefinder focusing method
- Kowa anamorphic adapters
- Sankor projection lenses
- Variable diopter solutions
- SLR Magic Rangefinder
- Isco Micro format
- Vintage lens modification
- Anamorphic lens setup
- Premium Optics Rangefinder
- Sony A7s compatibility

## Product Catalog

- [Anamorphic Lenses Archives - Anamorphic Lenses Store](https://www.anamorphicstore.com/lens-category/anamorphic-lenses): Main product catalog featuring Isco, Schneider, and Sankor lens kits
- [Large Lenses Archives - Anamorphic Lenses Store](https://www.anamorphicstore.com/lens-category/large-lenses): Large format Isco Schneider anamorphic lens product category

## Setup & Configuration Guides

- [Choosing the Right Anamorphic Lens Guide](https://www.anamorphicstore.com/choosing-an-anamorphic-lens): Comprehensive guide for selecting DSLR anamorphic lenses and setups
- [How to Single Focus with All Anamorphic Lenses](https://www.anamorphicstore.com/single-focus-anamorphic-conversion): Guide to converting anamorphic lenses like Isco, Kowa to single focus
- [Anamorphic Lens Calculator: What Lenses Will Work?](https://www.anamorphicstore.com/anamorphic-lens-calculator): Interactive calculator for DSLR anamorphic lens compatibility and specs

## Post-Production Workflow

- [Comprehensive Editing Anamorphic Footage & Anamorphic VIsual Effects](https://www.anamorphicstore.com/editing-anamorphic-footage-premiere-after-effects): Post-production workflow guide for Premiere Pro and After Effects
